CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   C. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

10. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   C. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   D. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   B. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sanctity of Life 3 5.4 Alcohol, drugs and Substance Abuse 3 5.5 Social Media 3 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sanctity of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
